AWS Bedrock returns 403 Forbidden (not 401) when credentials are missing, expired, or the IAM role lacks bedrock:InvokeModel permission — verifies the error is mapped to Authentication

```elixir title="Elixir"
try do
  api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
  {:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
  result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0\"}")
rescue
  error -> IO.puts(:stderr, "#{inspect(error.__struct__)}: #{Exception.message(error)}")
end
```
